title: Angular binding
description: Framework-specific binding for angular. The semantic root element is declared once in packages/platform-web/components.json. A WC host tag is derived from component identity, independently of the semantic root.

component.description: Must match the contract's `component`, the directory name, and the exported class.

contract.description: Relative path to the agnostic contract this realises.

framework.description: Named explicitly so a directory can hold more than one binding without ambiguity.

propOverrides.description: Where a contract axis is exposed under a different input name in Angular, because the framework already owns the canonical one. Keyed by axis name.

reason.description: Required. A rename with no reason is drift with paperwork.
